prompt: Create a genuinely excellent consumer mobile app UI design board for 'Uni Companion', a university course study and discussion app. TWO large portrait Android screens side by side, crisp readable app text, front-on flat screens, no device mockup hardware, no marketing headlines outside screens, narrow light-gray gutters. Entirely NEW art direction, youthful character-driven learning app with the precision and delight of Duolingo or Headspace. Original visual identity: electric cobalt blue primary, juicy tangerine orange mascot and highlights, clean white canvas, dark navy ink, occasional pale periwinkle section surfaces. Bold rounded geometric sans-serif typography, NO serif anywhere. Custom friendly rounded icon family, comfortable spacing, purposeful tactile buttons with shallow darker bottom edge and physical press feel, controlled thick outlines. One original character throughout: small soft tangerine-orange rounded four-point star creature, navy bean eyes, expressive eyebrows, short arms and tiny cobalt sneakers. Professional flat vector illustration craft with selective subtle dimensional shading; no emoji, no owl, no generic AI sparkle, no gradients, no dashboard KPI tiles, no stock photography, no cream/forest-green editorial aesthetic. Material Android safe areas, 48dp targets, recognizable bottom navigation. Feels designed for actual daily use, playful but not infantilizing. Fictional sample course content. Left screen HOME: compact app bar Uni Companion, profile avatar. Friendly heading 'Ready for a little progress?' with a small orange star character stretching beside the text, not a giant hero. Feature one distinctive cobalt study panel 'Pick up where you left off', 'Database Systems', 'Lecture 06 · Normalization', obvious white 'Continue' button. Below 'Your courses', three highly legible compact rows with custom illustrated course badges: CSC 301 Database Systems (stacked database disks), CSC 305 Software Engineering (interlocking pieces), CSC 307 Operating Systems (friendly processor). Small text link 'See all courses'. Bottom navigation Learn, Discuss, You with Learn selected. Right screen COURSE: back bar 'Database Systems', compact Study/Discuss segmented tabs. Heading 'Make sense of your notes.' Small inline star holding a blue document. One clear 'Upload lecture notes' outlined action. Below 'Your lectures' with a sequential vertical list: '01 Relational models' marked Reviewed, '02 SQL joins' marked Ready to practise, '03 Normalization' with prominent 'Study' action. Summary and Quiz affordances on active lecture. Preserve useful density, clear navigation, and distinctive authored illustration.
